description: This file contains unit tests for the in-memory grain storage provider in an Orleans-based application. It verifies the correct implementation of persistence operations, configuration of multiple storage providers, and ensures that the in-memory storage behaves as expected during testing scenarios.

classes.description: Unit test class for in-memory grain storage provider, inheriting from GrainPersistenceTestsRunner and using a fixture for test setup.
